class.name: FmodListener2D
class.brief_description: A 2D audio listener node for FMOD spatial audio.
class.description:
FmodListener2D represents a 2D audio listener for FMOD's spatial audio system. It defines where the "ears" are located in 2D space, affecting how positioned audio from [FmodEventEmitter2D] nodes is heard.
FMOD supports up to 8 simultaneous listeners, which can be useful for split-screen games or complex audio scenarios. Each listener has an index (0-7) and a weight that determines how much influence it has on the final audio mix.
The listener automatically tracks its node's position and updates FMOD's listener attributes accordingly. When the node is removed from the scene tree, it automatically unregisters itself from the FMOD system.
Key features: - Automatic 2D position tracking - Support for multiple listeners with weighted mixing - Listener locking to prevent position updates - Integration with FMOD's 2D spatialization system

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the listener is locked and won't update its position automatically.
The index of this listener (0-7). Each listener in the scene must have a unique index. Multiple listeners can be used for split-screen games or complex audio scenarios.
The weight of this listener. Higher weights give the listener more influence on the audio mix when multiple listeners are active.
